name: Hourglass
tagline: Time tracking and timesheets for freelancers and consultants
description: For freelancers and consultants who bill by the hour across several clients. It tracks time with a timer or by hand, flags overlaps and budget overruns, and turns the hours into exact billable totals and a printable timesheet.
scope: Timer that survives reloads, plus focus sessions
Day timeline and editable week timesheet
Rates, budgets, reports and printable timesheets
features: Start/stop timer stored as a start timestamp, shown in the tab title and intact after reloads
Focus sessions with configurable work and break intervals and a Web Audio chime
Day timeline with drag-to-add, overlap warnings and splitting, plus a week grid with editable cells
Rounding to none, 6 or 15 minutes, applied once per entry even across midnight
Reports filtered by date, client, project, tag and billable, with hand-built SVG charts
Budget progress and over-budget alerts, printable timesheet, CSV and JSON export, validated JSON import
engineering: Entries are cut at each local midnight while rounding applies once to the whole entry, and money is summed in exact cent-milliseconds and rounded only for display, so totals never pick up cent drift.
